ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/off-white) across approximately 85% of visible surface area, with low-intensity (black) pixel concentrations localized at the trailing edge periphery and central peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white core. Low-intensity black bands along the entire trailing edge. A centered triangular black field at the base. Discrete dark circular focal spots (0.5-2% of lobe area) distributed across both lobes, with higher density on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 50 degrees; depth extends roughly 15% into the total vertical span of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge. Pixel amplitude of peaks varies from 2-10 pixels. Serrations are more pronounced on the outer thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve with a sharp upward sweep; leading edge exhibits a moderate concave trajectory towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Right lobe contains a cluster of approximately 6-8 rosette-like rings/dots. Left lobe features smaller, less defined dark clusters near the upper-outer quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, roughly parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the lower right lobe, oriented diagonally from the lower central area toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant encrustation (barnacle colonization) visible on the distal tips and along the leading edges, appearing as rough, high-relief textured boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a single dark avian silhouette (bird) in the background pixels directly above the fluke's right lobe.
